# <span id="aanchor35"></span> Liquid Quality Source Overview

A liquid quality source is used to organize, validate and calculate liquid analysis information which can then be applied to one or more meters as identified by meter-to source assignments. Typically, a laboratory performs the analysis and provides a source text file which can be imported into a liquid quality source, or a printed/pdf lab report that can be hand-keyed into the source.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 284;height: 172;" />

Analyses imported into a meter can be “sent” to an assigned source where the configured validations and calculation will take place. Subsequently, these analyses can be applied to additional meters as described above.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 367;height: 188;" />
